title: Aina za Nomino (Theme 2: Huduma ya kwanza)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child uses the ku- form of a verb as the name of the activity (kusoma, kuogelea) in the place of a noun.
representations: a verb and verbal noun pair
steps: Use it where a noun goes.

board.say: Ni shughuli gani ni nzuri kwa afya?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Kuogelea ni kuzuri kwa afya" and one sentence of his own.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "___ kunafurahisha." Kwa nini "Soma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Nomino ya kitenzi-jina huanza na ku-: kusoma, kucheza, kulima. Shina la kitenzi peke yake haliwezi kuwa nomino hapa.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "___ ni muhimu kwa kila mtoto." Kwa nini "Anasoma" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Anasoma ni kitenzi chenye mtu na wakati. Kitenzi-jina ni kusoma, kinachotumika kama nomino bila mtu wala wakati.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "___ kunakuza akili." Kwa nini "Msomaji" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Msomaji ni mtu anayesoma. Kitenzi-jina hutaja kitendo chenyewe: kusoma.

checks.question: Ni kitenzi-jina kipi: msomaji, kusoma, anasoma?
